name.en: XY-MD02 temperature and humidity sensor (Modbus RTU)
name.zh-Hant: XY-MD02 溫濕度感測器（Modbus RTU）

description.en: Temperature and humidity read every 30 s with function 04 (input registers 0001–0002, both × 0.1; temperature is signed).
description.zh-Hant: 每 30 秒用功能碼 04 讀溫度和濕度（輸入暫存器 0001–0002，都是 × 0.1；溫度有正負號）。

description.en: Modbus address 01–F7 (factory 01). Every device on the bus needs its own.
description.zh-Hant: Modbus 位址 01–F7（出廠 01）。同一條匯流排上每台設備的位址都要不同。

notes.en: Some answer frames printed in the manual have wrong CRCs; the template follows the Modbus standard. The sensor also has ASCII commands: do not send AUTO on a shared bus (it then reports by itself). Firmware versions differ in the baud rate register, so the template leaves it alone.
notes.zh-Hant: 手冊印的幾個回覆框 CRC 是錯的，範本照 Modbus 標準。感測器另有 ASCII 指令：接在共用匯流排上時不要送 AUTO（它會開始自己定時上報）。不同韌體的鮑率暫存器寫法不同，範本不去改它。
